name: Ecumenical Hunger Program
description: The Ecumenical Hunger Program (EHP) has served East Palo Alto and surrounding communities for 50 years with food boxes, hot lunches, fresh produce, clothing, and other basic necessities.
fullDescription: The Ecumenical Hunger Program (EHP) has served East Palo Alto and surrounding communities for 50 years with food boxes, hot lunches, fresh produce, clothing, and other basic necessities.
whatTheyOffer:
- Nutritionally balanced emergency food boxes, Monday-Thursday
- Food bags for people without a way to cook or store food
- Fresh produce (Second Harvest delivery every Tuesday, plus EHP's garden)
- Hot lunch Monday-Thursday after 11am
- Pack the Bag snacks and light meals for children
- Back-to-school and holiday help for families
- Clothing and household items
howToGetIt: Visit EHP at 2411 Pulgas Avenue, East Palo Alto. Food box pickup is Monday-Thursday, 9am-12pm and 2pm-5pm (closed Friday-Sunday; holiday schedule in November and December). Call 650-323-7781 with questions.
address: 2411 Pulgas Avenue, East Palo Alto, CA 94303
keywords: Ecumenical Hunger Program, EHP, East Palo Alto, food boxes, free food, produce, hot lunch, clothing, furniture, San Mateo County
